response.sql: SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_customers_per_rep FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer GROUP BY SupportRepId);

assumptions.assumption: Customers with a NULL SupportRepId form one group, which the request specifies. GROUP BY places all NULLs together, and AVG is taken over the groups, not the customers, so each group counts equally.
AVG is unrounded. Results are returned as a floating-point value (SQLite and most engines return a non-integer average for integer input), so no rounding is applied.
